experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: I currently work on an AI Factory designed to accelerate the software engineering lifecycle at ADP. The platform combines agent harnesses, engineering loops, and multi-agent orchestration to plan, execute, validate, and review changes using different models. In practice, work that previously took several weeks has already been completed in one, while keeping quality and cost under control. I contribute to the platform's architecture, define how agents collaborate, and turn ambiguous engineering problems into tools that developers can use in real workflows. Before joining this team, I was one of the main engineers behind the MyTax mobile app, working across Flutter, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and architecture decisions.
experiences.companyInfo: ADP builds products and services around payroll, HR, tax, benefits, and workforce management, serving businesses and workers around the world. I work within ADP's product and engineering organization on newer digital products and platforms.

experiences.title: Development Consultant
experiences.description: At SAP, I worked on Ariba Category Management, an enterprise platform for strategic procurement. In a global environment shaped by complex business rules and integrations across multiple systems, I developed backend solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and SAP BTP. My role extended beyond implementation: I contributed to architecture decisions, code reviews, and the evolution of solutions that needed to remain clear and maintainable within a large platform. I also integrated AI capabilities into the product and supported other developers through complex technical problems. The experience helped consolidate my work in software architecture and engineering at SAP's scale.
experiences.companyInfo: SAP develops enterprise software used by companies around the world to manage areas such as finance, procurement, supply chain, HR, and operations. I worked within the SAP Ariba organization, focused on procurement and category management products.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description: I joined Bazk as a trainee and grew into a full-stack engineering role. I worked on payment systems processing more than 400 transactions per minute, where reliability, security, and observability had a direct impact. My work covered backend services, payment flows, compliance rules, internal tools, testing, infrastructure, and production monitoring. It was where I learned, in practice, how distributed systems behave and what it means to build software that moves real money.
experiences.companyInfo: Bazk was a fintech focused on payment infrastructure for e-commerce, handling payment processing, checkout flows, financial integrations, and compliance-related systems.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
experiences.description: My first professional software role was at Pling Brasil, where I joined as a trainee and worked on Universos, a news aggregator built around web scraping. I worked across the stack, building Node.js services and APIs, MongoDB integrations, and React interfaces. It was where I learned how to build a product with a team, ship code, fix real problems, and turn ideas into something people could use.
experiences.companyInfo: Pling Brasil was a small software development startup building digital products and providing development services for clients.
